answers.description: Austriadactylus, a variant of Pterodactyl, is a highly customizable, ultra-low-cost system optimized for binary classification in translation triage and data curation. It is based on an LLM-as-a-judge approach, with prompt engineering and model selection guided by ROC analysis. Unlike Pterodactyl, Austriadactylus uses GPT-5.6 for ultra-low-resource languages (Ladin, Ligurian, and Northern Sami).
answers.name: Austriadactylus, a variant of Pterodactyl
